faqs.question: Can I request S-parameter files for a SONNE component?
faqs.answer: Yes. Submit the product line, model or part number, required frequency range and port details through the document request form. SONNE will check whether a suitable file is available for that specific component and confirm the next step. Availability and any confidentiality requirements are reviewed per project rather than assumed for every product.
faqs.intent: 确认 S 参数是否可申请以及申请所需输入
faqs.snippet: 目标是 45–60 词的段落式 Featured Snippet，直接回答可申请、必填信息和项目级确认。

faqs.question: Can I request 2D and 3D drawings for a custom part?
faqs.answer: You can request 2D drawings or 3D CAD for a custom part by identifying the product, drawing format and intended design use. Include the mechanical envelope, connector or interface requirements and any known revision. The engineering team will first confirm the applicable document version and whether the requested file can be shared for your project.
faqs.intent: 评估定制图纸获取路径与设计导入条件
faqs.snippet: 目标是编号步骤或 45–60 词答案，列出型号、格式、接口与版本核对。

faqs.question: Are sample test reports the results for my own parts?
faqs.answer: No. A sample test report shows the document structure and the kind of evidence a test can provide; it is not evidence for your own parts. Results for a project must relate to the actual sample or production batch and the agreed test scope. Ask for the relevant report context before using any values in a design review.
faqs.intent: 澄清样例报告与项目实测报告的证据边界
faqs.snippet: 目标是以 No 开头的 45–60 词直接答案，适合澄清型摘要。

faqs.question: What if I do not know the exact model number?
faqs.answer: You can still start with the product line, application, frequency range and the document you need. Add connector, mechanical or performance requirements when known, and mark uncertain fields as unknown. SONNE can use that information to identify whether a relevant standard document exists or whether your requirement needs a custom engineering review.
faqs.intent: 降低无型号买家的资料申请门槛
faqs.snippet: 目标是 45–60 词段落，突出可从应用和频段开始，不要求先知道型号。

faqs.question: Do drawing requests require an NDA?
faqs.answer: Confidentiality requirements depend on the document and project. Select the confidentiality discussion option in the request form and describe what you intend to share or receive before uploading sensitive material. SONNE will confirm the appropriate arrangement for that specific request; the website does not imply a universal NDA scope or automatic acceptance for every drawing exchange.
faqs.intent: 确认图纸交换前的保密处理方式
faqs.snippet: 目标是 45–65 词条件式答案，避免统一 NDA 政策断言。

faqs.question: Is SONNE a factory or a trading company?
faqs.answer: SONNE is an engineering and manufacturing company founded in 2015, with a manufacturing base in Cixi, Ningbo, China. Its production capabilities include more than 50 high-precision CNC machines and RF testing resources. You can review factory photographs, machining, assembly and testing areas on the Factory page before arranging a project-specific audit or visit.

faqs.snippet: 目标是 50–65 词品牌实体答案，包含成立时间、基地与可核验路径。

faqs.question: Where is SONNE based?
faqs.answer: SONNE's manufacturing base is at No. 87, 89, 91, Sanbei Middle Road, Xinze Village, Guanhaiwei Town, Cixi City, Ningbo City, Zhejiang Province, China. Visitors should arrange a factory visit in advance through the Contact page so the team can confirm the schedule, site access and the people you need to meet.

faqs.question: Does SONNE support custom RF and enclosure projects?
faqs.answer: Yes. SONNE supports custom RF and microwave filters, waveguide components, combiners, base-station RF hardware and precision enclosure projects. Core production covers DC to 40 GHz, while selected custom microwave and waveguide designs may reach 110 GHz depending on topology and verification. Feasibility, documentation and test scope are evaluated against each project's requirements.
faqs.intent: 评估定制产品范围及高频能力边界

faqs.question: What do SONNE's capacity figures mean for a buyer?
faqs.answer: More than 50 high-precision CNC machines and annual capacity above 500,000 units indicate manufacturing resources for prototype-to-volume evaluation. They do not create a universal lead-time promise for every design. Your schedule still depends on drawings, quantities, processes and current capacity, so the project team should confirm timing after reviewing the actual RFQ.

faqs.question: Can I audit the SONNE factory in person?
faqs.answer: You can request an in-person factory audit through the Factory or Contact page. Include your company, product interest, audit objectives, preferred dates and the processes you need to review. SONNE will confirm availability, timing and accessible areas for the visit. A requested date is not confirmed until the team responds with the visit arrangements.
faqs.intent: 确认现场验厂是否可申请及预约边界
faqs.snippet: 目标是 50–60 词流程型答案，列出申请信息和确认条件。

faqs.question: Can I request a remote factory review?
faqs.answer: You can ask for a remote review and identify the machining, assembly or testing areas relevant to your audit. The team will confirm what can be presented and whether a suitable remote session can be arranged. For a useful review, send your audit checklist in advance and separate general capability questions from evidence needed for your specific project.
faqs.intent: 评估远程验厂可能性并提高审核效率
faqs.snippet: 目标是 45–60 词条件式答案，适合远程审核搜索意图。

faqs.question: What equipment can I verify at the factory?
faqs.answer: The factory content covers high-precision CNC machining, automated and manual assembly, VNA tuning and RF test areas. SONNE states that it has more than 50 high-precision CNC machines plus VNA, PIM, reliability and matrix automated testing capabilities. For an audit, request the equipment and records relevant to your product rather than relying only on a general equipment list.
faqs.intent: 核对工厂设备范围并准备项目审核清单
faqs.snippet: 目标是 50–65 词列表或段落答案，区分画面、能力和项目证据。

faqs.question: Does annual capacity above 500,000 units guarantee my delivery date?
faqs.answer: No. Annual capacity above 500,000 units is a factory-level capability figure, not a delivery guarantee for an individual order. Production timing depends on the drawings, quantities, processes, validation requirements and available capacity. Submit the actual project details so the team can assess a schedule; prototype and mass-production timing should be confirmed separately.
faqs.intent: 澄清产能与订单交期的关系
faqs.snippet: 目标是以 No 开头的 45–60 词答案，适合交期顾虑摘要。

faqs.question: Is ±0.01 mm tolerance guaranteed for every RF component?
faqs.answer: No. For structures above 40 GHz, mechanical tolerance can reach ±0.01 mm depending on the design and manufacturing requirements. It is not a blanket guarantee across every component or feature. Share the drawing and identify critical dimensions so engineering can assess feasibility and the appropriate inspection approach for your specific part.

sections.name: Technical Fields
sections.question: 不同产品线应填写哪些技术参数，未知值如何处理？
sections.h2: Add the Specifications Engineers Need to Review
points: RF 动态字段：频率范围/中心频率、带宽、插损、回波损耗、抑制或隔离、功率、PIM、阻抗、连接器、机械包络、环境条件
波导增加频段、波导规格/法兰、极化、端口与隔离要求；合路/基站增加 band plan、4T4R/8TR、N28/N78 等已知限定
结构件字段：2D/3D 图、材料、外形尺寸、关键公差/GD&T、表面处理、散热/屏蔽要求、防护目标与装配约束
除公共必填项外技术字段可选并带 Unknown；提交时提示缺项会影响评估完整度，但不阻止早期咨询

faqs.question: Can I request a quote without complete specifications?
faqs.answer: Yes. Submit the product line, application, project stage and the specifications you already know, then mark uncertain fields as unknown. Engineering can use that information to identify missing inputs and clarify the next step. A complete RFQ is more likely to receive initial engineering feedback in about 24 hours; a formal quote requires sufficient technical and commercial information.
faqs.intent: 降低 RFQ 提交门槛并理解资料完整度影响
faqs.snippet: 目标是以 Yes 开头的 55–65 词答案，区分早期提交和正式报价。

faqs.question: What frequency range can I include in an RFQ?
faqs.answer: SONNE's core production range is DC to 40 GHz. Selected custom microwave and waveguide projects may reach 110 GHz, depending on topology and verification. Include your required bands, bandwidth and performance targets so engineering can assess feasibility. The upper frequency statement is not a blanket commitment for every component or design.
faqs.intent: 确认询价可覆盖的频率范围与高频边界
faqs.snippet: 目标是 45–55 词定义型答案，包含核心范围和选定项目条件。

faqs.question: What files should I upload with my RFQ?
faqs.answer: Upload the files that define your requirement: a band plan, RF specification, 2D drawing, 3D CAD or test requirements as applicable. Identify each file's purpose and revision where known. If the material is sensitive, you can request a confidentiality discussion first and submit only a non-sensitive summary until the exchange arrangements are confirmed.
faqs.intent: 准备 RFQ 附件并处理敏感资料上传顾虑
faqs.snippet: 目标是 45–60 词列表式答案，覆盖 band plan、drawing 与保密前置选择。

faqs.question: Does selecting the confidentiality option mean an NDA is accepted?
faqs.answer: No. The option tells SONNE that confidentiality should be discussed before sensitive material is exchanged. It does not mean a universal NDA has been accepted or define its scope. Describe your requirement and avoid uploading sensitive files until the appropriate project-specific arrangement has been confirmed by both parties.
faqs.intent: 澄清 NDA 选项的实际含义和文件交换边界
faqs.snippet: 目标是以 No 开头的 40–50 词答案，避免统一 NDA 政策断言。

faqs.question: Will I receive a firm price and delivery date within 24 hours?
faqs.answer: Not necessarily. The approximately 24-hour guideline refers to initial engineering feedback for a complete RFQ, not a guaranteed firm quotation or delivery commitment. Pricing and timing require review of the design, quantities, processes and capacity. The fastest approximately two-week reference applies only to prototyping in suitable cases, while mass-production timing is confirmed per project.
faqs.intent: 澄清 24 小时反馈、报价、打样与量产交期的区别
faqs.snippet: 目标是 50–60 词否定限定答案，适合响应承诺类摘要。
